Concept bore is substantially broader and guide arrangement more dispersed than the source-guided model. These changes are rejected. The ambiguous left dark region remains a plausible collar cast shadow, not a confirmed extra vent. Exact guide count/depth and hidden engineering remain interpretation.

The bound legacy audit contains only shadow0 and permanent open body1, with no source lid actions. Static export is deliberate; satellite launch entities and shared RIS2 construction are separate. Existing wear/contrast are subtler than the concept.
